info.name: Announcement Banner
info.summary: Show admin announcements as a banner on the Dashboard
info.description:
Tell your users about updates, maintenance windows and other news where they will see it: as a banner at the top of the Dashboard, Nextcloud's home page.
- Admins write announcements under **Administration settings > Announcement Banner**: a title, an optional message, a type (information, success, warning, error) and an optional "Learn more" link. - Schedule them: a banner can appear from a start date and disappear after an end date. - Users close a banner once and it stays closed for them; announcements that must stay visible (an upcoming maintenance window, for example) can be made non-dismissible. - Hand the management page to a group of non-admins under **Administration privileges**. - Automate it from update scripts with `occ announcement_banner:create`.
info.author: BurgiSimon
